name: matched-ks3-all-rank2-warp-prior
hypothesis: Make rank-two chart coupling active at initialization by setting the even Chebyshev warp coefficient c4 to+0.025 for both coordinates of every chart. Zero-initialized rank-two geometry initially reduces to independent ReLU-squared coordinates; this structured prior introduces nonzero within-chart cross derivatives immediately. Test its interaction with paired-coordinate geometry after rank-two zero initialization and rank-one c4+0.025 were separately proxy-pruned. Keep512 rank-two charts and1024 projection features in all dense/routed sites, original projection/geometry rates and decay, BF16/GS32, MoE8top1 and every shared/model-wide setting fixed. No validation advantage is inferred from earlier proxy observations.
